title: heading block props
description: A section heading inside a screen. The screen title is already rendered as the level-1 heading.
x-ai-instructions: Use headings to signal structure (guardrail E5). Use textRef when the plan has a locked text for it.

textRef.description: Id of a validated text of the plan: the block shows the plan's wording, and rewording it writes the plan.

level.description: Heading level. Do not skip levels.
